title: Testing Transformer Learnability on the Arithmetic Sequence of Rooted Trees
abstract: arXiv:2512.01870v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study whether a transformer network can learn the deterministic sequence of trees generated by the iterated prime factorization of the natural numbers. Each integer is mapped into a rooted planar tree and the resulting sequence $\mathbb{N}\mathscr{T}$ defines an arithmetic text with measurable statistical structure. A transformer network (the GPT-2 architecture) is trained from scratch on the first $10^{11}$ elements and evaluated on next-token prediction and masked-token prediction tasks, with a Hidden Markov Model as baseline and a scaling analysis over context window, dataset size, vocabulary size and model size. The model reaches a word accuracy of about $0.4$, well above the baseline, and its performance remains stable on test blocks located at $10^{13}$-$10^{15}$, far beyond the training interval. Moreover, the likelihood assigned by the trained model separates the arithmetic text from two controls: synthetic token sequences

translated_title: 测试Transformer在有根树算术序列上的可学习性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了Transformer网络能否学习由自然数迭代素数分解所生成的确定性树序列。每个整数被映射为一棵有根平面树，由此得到的序列 $\mathbb{N}\mathscr{T}$ 定义了一个具有可测量统计结构的算术文本。我们在前 $10^{11}$ 个元素上从头训练了一个Transformer网络（GPT-2架构），并在下一个词预测和掩码词预测任务上进行评估，以隐马尔可夫模型作为基线，并针对上下文窗口、数据集大小、词表大小和模型大小进行了缩放分析。该模型达到了约 $0.4$ 的词准确率，远高于基线，且其性能在位于 $10^{13}$-$10^{15}$ 的测试块上保持稳定，远超训练区间。此外，训练模型所赋予的似然能够将该算术文本与两个对照（合成词元序列等）区分开来。
tldr: 该论文将自然数通过迭代素数分解映射为有根树构成的确定性算术文本，并证明从头训练的GPT-2模型能以约0.4的词准确率学习该序列，且在远超训练范围的测试数据上保持稳定的外推性能。
en_tdlr: This paper maps natural numbers into rooted trees via iterated prime factorization and shows that a GPT-2 transformer trained from scratch can learn the resulting deterministic arithmetic sequence with ~0.4 word accuracy, while maintaining stable performance on test blocks far beyond the training range.
